title: a launch of a saved build prints no layer suffix on the card, and the registry line records the layer repo, the real file and the SHA-256 of its bytes
source: intended: builds come from the repo's jitso/builds folder and from drafts (docs/decisions.md, The v0.1.0 cut)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers, narrowed by the v0.1.0 cut). Every launch line of the registry carries build_layer (repo or draft), build_file (the real absolute path of the build file) and build_sha256 (the SHA-256 of the file's bytes, not of anything re-encoded), so a record names exactly which file a session was launched from. The card header of a saved build has no suffix; the header of a draft ends with ` (draft)` (launch/draft cases). The registry line carries build and build_version (v: 2, defect N-31).
